name: @forest/issuer
description: The Forest Foundation's issuer: it checks with Didit that a person is one real person and signs the standard's notes. A face check, free, gives a note from its face key; an ID check, offered only with a price, a note from its ID key, once per name and birth date. Each note's attributes are a fixed Poseidon recipe of what the check saw, kept beside it for the person. It keeps which check session gave which note number and, for the ID check, a keyed hash of the name and birth date. At a note number's first face note it signs a sponsor's ticket for the host credits the person's app buys.
